title: 第十七章 交锋第十八章 刷存在感
slug: 诸天影视从四合院开始
content_zh:
何雨水犹如被人用大锤在脑袋上猛砸了一下，顿时间感觉头昏脑胀的，过了好一会儿才回过了神，看着自己的男友，开口说道：
“怎么会这样？你没跟我开玩笑吧？”
男人有些无奈的苦笑了一下，然后开口说道：
“我都希望这是一个玩笑，但是这就是事实，我托人打听了，受害人许大茂现在都还在医院里住院呢，据说已经做完手术了，被彻底给截了，从此再没了烦恼根。”
何雨水的身子晃了晃，好悬没摔倒在地，这时男人眼疾手快，一把上前搀扶住了何雨水，只听他开口说道：
“你哥现在算是倒下了，你可不能再倒下，要不然，你们这个家可就真的要散了。”
何雨水作为一个女人，心思是何等的细腻，一听就听出了男友的言外之意，知道自己家这是被人嫌弃了，因为他在称呼家的时候，用的是“你们”
而不是“咱们”
要知道这时人们还都很保守，谁家要是出了个作奸犯科的人，那可真是全家都会被人在后面戳脊梁骨的，看来自己的这桩婚事要悬了，想到这里，何雨水脸上的表情不禁有些黯然。
何雨水转念又一想，都到了这个时候了，自己哥哥出了这么一档子事儿，哪怕是自己的男友坚持，自己和他也不可能在年底办婚礼了，因为自己除了现在这个相依为命的哥哥，身边也再没旁人了。
这时就听男人开口说道：
“现在的当务之急是想办法调查出案件中的纰漏，尽可能的减轻你哥身上的罪责，我在所里仔细的研究了一下你哥的笔录，我发现了其中的一个蹊跷，我在私下里调查着这件事，还需要你的帮忙。”
何雨水听到和哥哥傻柱的案子有关，抬起了头，看了眼男友，然后开口问道：
“你说，能办到的我马上去办，不能办到的我想办法也要去办！”
“今天来派出所报案的，是受害人的妻子娄小娥和你们一个院儿的邻居叶晨，现在最大的疑点就是他们是怎么知道许大茂被你哥给绑在了食堂？娄小娥还在医院里陪着自己的丈夫，情绪比较激动，一时半会儿还缓不过来，我打算去问问另一位报案人，你们一个院儿的叶晨，需要你来给我引路。”
何雨水的男友开口说道。
听自己的男友说完，何雨水立马点头答应，此时电影也顾不上看了，和男友一起，骑着自行车，朝着自己住的四合院儿驶去。
叶晨下了班，吃完了晚饭之后，收拾利索，正坐在自己的屋里看书，炕桌上的大茶缸子还冒着热气，里面是叶晨用高碎泡的茶水，叶晨一边饮着茶一边看着书，突然间门口传来了敲门声，然后就听见一个女生在门口问道：
“叶晨在家吗？”
叶晨一听声音就知道是何雨水在外面，他笑了笑，嘴里应了句：

“在家，等会儿，我这就给你开门！”
说罢，叶晨下了炕，趿拉上了板儿鞋，来到了门口，打开了房门，只见何雨水和一个男人站在门口，叶晨的眼睛瞬间一眯，然后恢复了正常，只听他开口说道：
“雨水，这是你爱人吧？长的真精神，上次在街上看见你们在一起的时候，就觉得你们很般配，什么时候结婚？我也跟着混块喜糖吃。
来，别再在门口杵着了，赶紧屋里坐。”
说罢，叶晨朝着屋里比划了一个手势，邀请着二人进屋，何雨水还没反应过味儿来，但是她的男朋友却第一时间听出了弦外之音，这是个厉害的家伙，一打照面儿，就把自己的目的看的一清二楚，话里话外的点明了自己的身份，提醒自己在这件事中应该避嫌。
想到这里，何雨水的男朋友不由得叹了口气，跟着进了屋。
何雨水和男友进了屋，这时就见叶晨笑着说道：
“来炕上坐，炕上热乎，茶水是刚泡好的，喝点茶水暖暖身子。”
说完叶晨从茶盘上拿过了两个空水杯，给二人倒上了茶水，推到了二人的跟前。
何雨水打量了一下屋子，跟自己哥哥傻柱的房间相比，叶晨的房间要整洁的多，完全不像是一个单身男人的住所，到处都摆放的井井有条。
只见炕桌上还倒扣着一本《钳工装配工艺学》，这是正在看看书呢，看的还是这种工具书，何雨水对于叶晨的印象，瞬间从以前的小透明，变成了略带欣赏。
男人和女人欣赏的角度不同，何雨水的男朋友因为职业的缘故，进屋的第一时间，也打量了一下屋子里的陈设，他发现一切都布置的井井有条，这说明这个人的逻辑思维能力很强，再一回想刚才在门口，这个人对自己和何雨水说的话，他愈发肯定了自己的推断。
何雨水是风风火火的性子，现在什么事情在她的心里都没有自己哥哥傻柱的事情重要，现在见着了人，她第一时间把男朋友的疑惑问了出来：
“叶晨，听说今儿个一早，是你和娄小娥去派出所报的案，我有点搞不明白的是，你是怎么知道许大茂被我哥给绑了的？你又是怎么知道我哥在哪儿绑的？”
何雨水的男朋友一听何雨水的问话，心说坏了，自己忘了提醒何雨水，询问的时候要自己来，毕竟自己才是专业的，由她一个女孩子来问，太容易被搪塞过去了。
这时只见叶晨微微一笑，端着水杯砸吧了一口，吐了下嘴里的茶叶梗子，开口说道：
“昨个儿厂里放电影《阿斯玛》，放完的时候已经有些晚了，散场的时候我本打算和许大茂一起往回走的，发现他正和厂领导要去小食堂喝酒，我就自己一个人回来了，回家做完饭，对付了一口，我正打算看书学习，结果发现工具书被我带到了厂里，落在了更衣室了，于是我起身奔着厂里就过去了。
到了厂里，跟门卫打了招呼，我去更衣室把工具书拿上，往回走的时候，正好路过食堂，发现许大茂和领导的酒局正好结束。”

content_en:
He Yuyu felt as if someone had hit him on the head with a sledgehammer. He felt dizzy for a while. It took him a while to regain his senses. He looked at his boyfriend and said:
"How could this happen? You're not kidding me, are you?"
The man smiled helplessly, and then said:
"I hope this is a joke, but this is the truth. I asked someone to inquire and found that the victim Xu Damao is still in the hospital. It is said that he has completed the operation and was completely amputated. He has no more troubles."
He Yuyu's body swayed, and he barely managed to fall to the ground. At this moment, the man's quick eyesight and quick hands stepped forward to support He Yuyu, and heard him say:
"Your brother has fallen down now. You can't fall down again, otherwise, your family will really fall apart."
As a woman, He Yuyu has such a delicate mind. She could hear the implication of her boyfriend's words and knew that her family was being disliked because he used "you" when addressing his family.
rather than "we"
You must know that people were still very conservative at this time. If a criminal was found in any family, the whole family would be stabbed in the back. It seemed that his marriage was about to be suspended. Thinking of this, He Yuyu couldn't help but feel a little sad.
He Yuyu thought about it again, it was already this time, something happened to his brother, even if his boyfriend insisted, it would be impossible for him and her to have a wedding at the end of the year, because apart from the brother who now depends on each other, there is no one else around him.
At this time, I heard the man say:
"The top priority now is to find ways to investigate the flaws in the case and reduce your brother's guilt as much as possible. I carefully studied your brother's transcripts at the institute, and I found a strange thing in them. I am investigating this matter privately, and I still need your help."
When He Yuyu heard that it was related to his brother Shazhu's case, he raised his head, glanced at his boyfriend, and then asked:
"You said, if I can do it, I will do it right away. If I can't do it, I will try my best to do it!"
"The people who came to the police station to report the crime today are Lou Xiao'e, the victim's wife, and Ye Chen, a neighbor from one of your courtyards. The biggest doubt now is how they knew that Xu Damao was tied up in the cafeteria by your brother? Lou Xiao'e is still in the hospital with her husband. She is very emotional and can't calm down for a while. I plan to ask the other reporter, Ye Chen, who is from one of your courtyards, needs you to guide me."
He Yuyu's boyfriend said.
After hearing what his boyfriend said, He Yuyu immediately nodded in agreement. At this time, he stopped watching the movie and rode his bicycle with his boyfriend towards the courtyard where he lived.
Ye Chen got off work, finished dinner, tidied up, and was sitting in his room reading a book. The big tea vat on the kang table was still steaming. In it was tea made by Ye Chen with high broken powder. Ye Chen was drinking tea while reading a book. Suddenly, there was a knock on the door, and then he heard a girl asking at the door:
"Is Ye Chen at home?"
When Ye Chen heard the voice, he knew that He Yuyu was outside. He smiled and said:
"At home, wait a minute, I will open the door for you!"
After that, Ye Chen got off the kang, put on his sneakers, came to the door, opened the door, and saw He Yuyu and a man standing at the door. Ye Chen's eyes narrowed for an instant, and then returned to normal, and he only heard him say:
"Yu Yu, is this your lover? She's so energetic. The last time I saw you two together on the street, I thought you were a perfect match. When will you get married? I'll eat some wedding candy too.
Come on, stop standing at the door and sit inside. "
After saying that, Ye Chen made a gesture toward the house and invited the two of them to come in. Before He Yuyu could react,But her boyfriend heard the implication immediately. He was a powerful guy. As soon as he met her, he saw her purpose clearly. He made his identity clear in his words and reminded himself that he should avoid suspicion in this matter.
Thinking of this, He Yuyu's boyfriend couldn't help but sigh and followed him into the house.
He Yuyu and her boyfriend entered the house and saw Ye Chen smiling and saying:
"Come and sit on the kang. It's hot. The tea has just been brewed. Drink some tea to warm yourself up."
After saying that, Ye Chen took two empty water cups from the tea tray, poured tea for the two of them, and pushed them in front of them.
He Yuyu looked around the room. Compared with his brother Silly Zhu's room, Ye Chen's room was much neater. It didn't look like a single man's residence at all. Everything was neatly arranged.
I saw a copy of "Fitter Assembly Technology" lying upside down on the kang table. He was reading a book, and he was still reading this kind of reference book. He Yuyu's impression of Ye Chen instantly changed from being transparent to being slightly appreciative.
Men and women appreciate things from different angles. Because of his profession, He Yuyu’s boyfriend took a look at the furnishings in the house as soon as he entered the house. He found that everything was arranged in an orderly manner, which showed that this man had strong logical thinking ability. After recalling what this man said to himself and He Yuyu at the door just now, he became more and more sure of his inference.
He Yuyu has a fiery temperament. Nothing is as important in her heart as her brother Silly Zhu. Now that she meets someone, she immediately asks her boyfriend's doubts:
"Ye Chen, I heard that you and Lou Xiao'e went to the police station to report the case early this morning. What I don't understand a bit is, how did you know that Xu Damao was kidnapped by my brother? And how did you know where my brother was kidnapped?"
When He Yuyu's boyfriend heard He Yuyu's questions, he was heartbroken. He forgot to remind He Yuyu that he had to do it by himself when asking questions. After all, he was the professional. It would be too easy for her, a girl, to ask questions.
At this time, Ye Chen smiled slightly, took a drink from the water glass, spit out the tea stems in his mouth, and said:
"The movie "Asma" was shown in the factory yesterday, and it was a little late when it ended. When the show ended, I planned to walk back with Xu Damao, but I found that he was going to the canteen with the factory leader for a drink, so I came back alone. After going home, I finished cooking and took a bite. I was about to read and study, but I found that the reference book was brought to the factory and left in the locker room, so I got up and ran to the factory.
When I arrived at the factory, I greeted the guard and went to the locker room to pick up the reference books. When I was walking back, I happened to pass by the cafeteria and found that the wine party between Xu Damao and his leader had just ended. "
